entries.name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on Family 30 hinge chain (spine 23.92, neck 9.00, thigh 22.06, shin 22.49 exact) with the hips 6 to 13 units behind the ankles. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a barbell rear delt row to the upper

frames.caption: Take a wide overhand grip on the bar. Stand tall with the ribs down and the implement in hand.
Soften the knees and send the hips back into the hinge.
Hang the long arms beneath the braced torso.
Drive the elbows wide and pull to the upper chest.
Lower to long arms without rising.

entries.name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
entries.reason: Independent draft repair: world-transverse shoulder abduction at fixed15deg elbow flexion; projected45deg oblique camera. World arm lengths12.5/12 are exposed by the production solver for independent inspection. Quiet horizontal trunk and per-body forehead/pad surface contact. No row or front-raise alias.
entries.summary: Raise the arms out to the sides with the forehead supported.

frames.caption: Keep the forehead on the bench and let the dumbbells hang under the shoulders.
Raise the arms out to the sides with one small, fixed elbow bend.
Bring the upper arms level with the floor while the torso stays still.
Hold the lateral raise for one second with the forehead supported.
Lower both arms along the same lateral arc to the hanging start.
